purpose: Stable hierarchical task stack. Every new science action must justify itself against all parent levels before execution.

L0_NORTH_STAR.goal: Qualify full MeanVC2 Vocos cold4/warm6 under strict QNN ownership/no CPU fallback: frozen host numerical gate first, host structural qualification second, target-phone HTP final truth third, then production integration in lly8666/SimAdmin-Android.
L0_NORTH_STAR.success: Host numerical+structural qualification passes, then frozen device qualification passes without threshold relaxation or CPU fallback.
L0_NORTH_STAR.contingency: If exact/equivalent numerical-topology recovery becomes causally exhausted, switch to learned residual / wider multi-block or full-Vocos student / qualified-surrogate route.

L1_PHASE.goal: Host numerical recovery: reduce full47 max_abs from current 0.0004115104675292969 to <=0.0003 while preserving semantic gates and protected-data boundaries.
L1_PHASE.exit_success: Numerical gate passes -> stop search and enter host structural qualification.
L1_PHASE.exit_stall: This embed-Conv family is the final exact/equivalent family by default after the closed reduction-tree mechanism. If it fails material full47 progress, activate L0 contingency instead of adding more exact micro-variants.

L2_MECHANISM.name: EMBED_CONV_ACCUMULATION_GROUPING
L2_MECHANISM.causal_reason: Nonperturbing stem/block0 taps plus full-graph default-ORT delta injection show the warm18 embed-Conv intrinsic residual is strongly aligned with the observed final failure (cosine ~0.979, projection ~53.4%) and has enough leverage to exceed the remaining ~27.1% gate gap. Block0 LN/PW1/PW2 intrinsic vectors are mostly compensating on warm18 and must not be targeted merely because their local max error is larger.
L2_MECHANISM.mechanism_budget: Exactly one narrow family: contiguous embed-Conv input-channel split counts {2,4,8}, bias added once after fixed balanced reduction. No additional split counts, PW/LN changes, or adjacent rewrites may be introduced after seeing QNN results.
L2_MECHANISM.exit_success: A preregistered winner delivers >=3% material full47 max improvement with semantic PASS; if <=3e-4 proceed immediately to structural qualification.
L2_MECHANISM.exit_failure: No material full47 improvement -> exact/equivalent route is causally exhausted by default; return to L1/L0 and activate learned-residual/wider-student/qualified-surrogate contingency.

L3_EXPERIMENT.question: Can changing only the front-end embed Conv input-channel accumulation grouping reduce the same-direction intrinsic residual identified by full-graph injection without destabilizing the rest of the real warm trajectory?
L3_EXPERIMENT.method: Freeze outcome-independent real-warm Stage1/2/3 split before QNN; warm18 is Stage3-only. Test exactly split2/split4/split8. All candidates already pass ORT1.27 semantic Stage1. Run frozen current-best baseline plus three candidates on Stage1; score only after all four units complete. Unique promoted winner only may see Stage2, then Stage3/full47.
L3_EXPERIMENT.closure: No Stage1 promoted winner closes the family immediately. A Stage2 failure closes it. Stage3/full47 promotion requires >=3% max improvement vs current host best and semantic PASS. No post-hoc split counts.

L4_ACTION.action: Run QNN2.44 CPU Stage1 on the frozen 15-block split for exactly baseline current-best, split2, split4 and split8; do not inspect comparative scores until all four units are complete, then apply preregistered promotion rule.
L4_ACTION.parent_alignment: This is the single evidence-backed exact/equivalent family allowed after post-tree causal re-localization. It directly targets the only identified same-direction intrinsic source with plausible leverage beyond the remaining gate gap.

mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_every_scored_experiment: Re-evaluate L3 against L2 before choosing another action.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_family_closure: Return to L2; do not create a sibling family automatically.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_two_consecutive_nonmaterial_experi: Stop mechanism-level tuning and perform causal re-localization.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.when_expected_leverage_is_small_relative: Do not spend a family on micro-tuning; justify a mechanism with plausible leverage or change route.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_one_additional_distinct_exact_fami: Return to L1/L0 and activate learned/student/surrogate contingency unless new causal evidence materially changes the model.

preflight_questions: What parent task does this action advance?
What causal mechanism makes it capable of material progress toward the remaining gate gap?
What result closes this experiment or mechanism?
What protected data must remain unseen?
If it fails, which parent level do we return to instead of adding variants?
